This might justify your frustration. - *Why?* Property laws generally protect owners from unauthorized use of their land. 2. **From a Social/Human Perspective (1):** - If Kate is a friend/family member and the yard is rarely used, you might argue that her guests were just being careless or unaware of boundaries.
